scenes.title: Welcome
scenes.caption: Welcome
scenes.narration: G’day. Jonesy here, introducing you to Geoff’s Guide. Let’s work through the tabs, from left to right.

scenes.title: Form
scenes.caption: Form
scenes.narration: Form gives you our original view of the race: the shortlist, the full field, and the form behind each runner. Start here to see who comes out on top.

scenes.title: Late Mail
scenes.caption: Late Mail
scenes.narration: Late mail brings in what changes as the day unfolds: conditions, scratchings, riders and fresh information. See our revised selection beside the original, and understand what moved it.

scenes.title: Tips
scenes.caption: Tips
scenes.narration: Tips brings together leading racing tipsters. Explore the collective view, then open each tip to see the reasoning, the assumed conditions, and the run that horse needs.

scenes.title: Ladder
scenes.caption: Ladder
scenes.narration: The Ladder connects the form. If two horses have met, who beat whom, and by how much? If they haven’t, a shared opponent can help connect them. It’s another way to weigh the evidence, rather than a guaranteed finishing order.

scenes.title: Results
scenes.caption: Results
scenes.narration: And Results shows how Geoff’s selections performed, alongside the jockeys, trainers and tipsters having a day out.

scenes.title: Geoff’S Edge
scenes.caption: Geoff’S Edge
scenes.narration: Come back five minutes before the jump for the latest saved late mail and race preview—Geoff’s edge. Happy punting!
